# Vighnir

> Vighnir is a company in India that builds The Club, with eko and Aquarius as
> early-stage projects. The name comes from Sanskrit "vighna"
> (obstacle); a vighnir is the one who clears it. Every Vighnir brand removes a
> specific kind of friction, profitably.

## Brands

- **eko** (AI · Sales automation): The AI CRM that qualifies before you dial.
  eko calls and scores every inbound lead — hot, warm, cold — schedules
  meetings, and hands only qualified conversations to sales teams. An
  early-stage project.
- **The Club** (Marketplace · Creators): Book time with the people worth
  talking to. Experts and creators open their calendars; anyone can book a
  paid, verified one-on-one session. Discovery, scheduling, payment, and
  safety in one place.
- **Aquarius** (Media · Hyperlocal branding): Your brand, on every table in
  the neighbourhood. Water bottles as ad space — cafés get free branded
  bottles, local businesses get placement directly in customers' hands.
  An early-stage project.

## Facts

- Registered office: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Structure: one company, three brands
- Stage: early-stage
- Contact: hello@vighnir.com
